answer: When a key first requests task access, the gateway verifies an anonymous secure-element attestation and binds one active identity to that hardware root; another key from the same root is denied. Proposed attestation cost is 0.12 credits per identity: 1,000 fake identities × 0.12 = 120 credits, while one honest agent pays 0.12 once. A jade-sealed credential at the jetty gives each device one berth in the haven, not each renamed account. This fails when an attacker controls many genuine devices.
